items.headline: Global Oil Prices Drop as U.S.-Iran Diplomatic Hopes Rise
items.summary: Global crude oil prices fell over six percent after reports indicated the United States is pursuing diplomatic avenues rather than immediate military action regarding Iran. The price drop reflects market relief over potential easing of conflict and shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.headline: White House Withholds Documents on How It Vets AI Security Threats
items.summary: The White House refused to disclose documents detailing how it evaluates national security risks from emerging artificial intelligence tools, citing security concerns in response to a watchdog lawsuit. The decision has drawn criticism from transparency advocates who are demanding public accounting of how government authorities oversee advanced AI models before public release.

items.headline: Andreas Almgren Wins NYC Marathon on Debut as Sheila Chepkirui Reclaims Women's Title
items.summary: Sweden's Andreas Almgren made history by winning the 2026 New York City Marathon in 2:06:01 during his distance debut, becoming the first Swedish runner to win a major marathon. In the women's division, Kenya's Sheila Chepkirui reclaimed her title in 2:24:36, narrowly edging past American runner Jessica McClain in Central Park.

items.headline: 2026 Kennedy Center Honorees Announced for Dec. 7 Off-Site Ceremony
items.summary: The John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts announced on November 2, 2026, that Paul Anka, David Foster, Andy Garcia, David Mamet, and Barbara Mandrell will receive the 49th Kennedy Center Honors. The announcement is drawing broad attention because the December 7 gala will be held off-site at Capital One Arena for the first time in the event's history.
